author: New China TV
description: From China's Inner Mongolia to Mongolia's Gobi Desert, Chinese ecological restoration expertise is crossing borders to help combat desertification. Drawing on more than 30 years of experience in restoring arid and semi-arid regions, Chinese experts are working with local partners to restore degraded land through proven techniques and the use of native plant species. By sharing technologies and experience, China is contributing practical solutions to the global fight against desertification.
title: China's ecological restoration expertise goes global to combat desertification

description:
He came from America. He stayed for the #pandas.
For 14 years, James Ayala has dedicated his life to studying and caring for giant pandas in #Chengdu, China.
Now an animal behavior researcher at the Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding, he's made a career out of his passion for these adorable black-and-white bears.
What's it like to spend 14 years with pandas? Watch his story and find out.
#GiantPanda #Chengdu #PandaLove #LifeInChina
